goals.0: Saying how often you do things: immer, oft, manchmal, nie
goals.1: The full forms of regular verbs (lernen, machen)
goals.2: Talking about free time and the weekend
goals.3: Practising where time words go in the sentence
dialog.5.de.2.n: nie = never — it already means “not”, so you don't need nicht
grammar.0.title: How often? — Häufigkeit
grammar.0.note: It goes right after the verb: Ich lerne oft Deutsch. / Ich schlafe nie früh.
grammar.1.intro: The pattern for regular verbs: drop -en from the infinitive and add the endings — e, st, t, en, t, en.
grammar.1.note: This pattern works for hundreds of verbs: wohnen, kommen, kaufen, kochen, trinken …
grammar.2.title: When a time word comes first, the verb stays in second place
grammar.2.text: Am Wochenende habe ich Zeit. — when „am Wochenende“ comes first, the subject ich goes after the verb.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “At the weekend I have time.”
